movie.title: Wonder
movie.overview: The story of August Pullman – a boy with facial differences – who enters fifth grade, attending a mainstream elementary school for the first time.

facts: Get this – the central character of 'Wonder' is a boy named August Pullman! His journey is truly at the heart of the story.
A specific detail you might find interesting is that August begins his adventure by entering fifth grade. It's a big step for him!
Perhaps most importantly, this is August's very first time attending a mainstream elementary school. Talk about a new experience!
